reason: No skill covers claiming, pairing, messaging, reporting or closing a Metaform tasks worktree. In the episode a claim overwrote a peer's held worksheet, a partner's reply was not seen, and a cited line pointed at the wrong function. A class-level skill makes the next pair run start with these rules.

Worksheet items named agents by name (SleekArmor, UntamedGiant); completion and planned-node matching compare item.agent against the task id, so the partner's row stayed complete: null until re-registered with task ids.
The worktree rule was stated wrong in the claim description; the code makes a worktree only for a composer-named worktree, and a ticket claimed by its own id is worked in the project folder.
A draft report cited a test file that does not exist; listing the folder before citing a name caught it.

The implementer's review handoff was one long multi-clause paragraph, and the shared files held other agents' uncommitted edits, so the diff showed far more than its own lines. The partner needed exact line ranges and a one-line form to review only its work.

The skill's first rule says a second claim replaces the holder without a refusal. The live worksheet code now refuses it, so the rule contradicts the code and would send an agent to overwrite a held worktree.
